title: EcoCard: Partner Merchants and Eco-Friendly Shopping Guide
summary: This EcoCard guide explains how to find and shop with approximately 3 certified green partner merchants using the in-app merchant directory, green badges, and checkout-page indicators. It also covers tips for recurring eco-friendly purchases, confirming the seller of record, receipt retention for review requests, and updating partner lists via the directory feedback option.
